the use of rIL- 2 in the modulation of human in vitro cytotoxicity and the effect of chemotherapeutic and cytotoxic agents on human NK cells and lymphokines activated killer cells.
the development of an in vitro system which will allow the investigation of immunomodulatory effects of chemotherapeutics and/or radiotherapeutics on human natural cytotoxic effector cells.
developing a rational basis for the use of rIL- 2 in combination with cytotoxic agents to treat cancer patients.
